title: Faravan v1 invite binding
description: Signature by the one-time invite private key over the exact root-signed Invite envelope, in domain faravan/invite-binding/v1: UTF-8 'faravan/invite-binding/v1', one NUL byte, then the raw SHA-256 of JCS(the whole envelope, signature included). key_id is the fingerprint of the Invite's invite_public_key. The owner device publishes it with the Invite; the coordinator never holds the invite private key, so it cannot create one. See v1.md section 5.1.
